messages:
Priya Nair: FYI noticed ~30 leads from last webinar landed in HubSpot without owner assigned. SLA shows 'unassigned > 5m -> escalate' but nothing fired.
Evan Brooks: that's bad. timezone mismatch maybe? webinar ran at 11:30pm UTC which is midnight PST.
Riley King: Salesforce inbound sync also delayed. sometimes owner property 'hs_owner' is blank until SF writeback completes.
Priya Nair: exact symptom: hubspot list shows owner=null, routing workflow expects 'recent_activity' to be set which only happens after enrichment. sequence stalled.
Ava Martinez: any errors in the enrichment queue?
LeadOps Bot: alert: 30 leads unassigned in last 45m; sf-sync failures=12; last webhook retry=3.
Evan Brooks: ok two fixes: 1) add a temporary 'hold-unassigned' rule that pins to fallback_owner=oncall_sales after 3m, 2) surface a 'pending_sf_write' flag so SLA doesn't suppress escalation.
Riley King: +1. Also reduce claim debounce for timezone-ed bursts: from 45s -> 20s for leads created between 22:00-02:00 UTC.
Priya Nair: can we add an explicit mapping in the HubSpot workflow: if hs_owner=null and source IN (webinar, demo_reg) -> assign 'oncall_sales' first, then RR after enrichment succeeds.
Ava Martinez: please add the mapping as a HubSpot workflow rule not a code change. easier to revert.
Evan Brooks: sample JSON rule for ops team: 
```
{"condition":"hs_owner IS NULL AND lead_source IN ['webinar','demo_reg']","action":"ASSIGN:oncall_sales","hold_for":"3m"}
```
Riley King: once we flip it on, instrument a count metric 'unassigned_leads_by_hour' and a SLA alert if >10 sustained for 30m.
LeadOps Bot: note: creating maintenance ticket MT-881 to track rule rollout.
Priya Nair: rollout plan: 1) create workflow in staging, 2) run with 1% traffic for 1h, 3) flip to 100% and monitor unassigned_leads metric. 4) follow up with postmortem if >5% fail.
Ava Martinez: I can do staging test now. tagging @Evan to approve prod flip.
Evan Brooks: approve after 1% sanity run. please include dashboard link in PR.
Riley King: quick win: I'll queue a retry for SF writes for the 12 failed ones with exponential backoff and lower concurrency.
Priya Nair: thanks all. I'll update the SLA doc to note fallback_owner behavior and put escalation matrix into confluence. reconvene 2pm to confirm numbers. :sparkles:
